title: Methods and debugging — Java Practice
description: Independent practice: A restaurant reuses a tip calculator. Seven questions with explanations.
author: DailyCoder

questions.explanation: It optionally provides a value to the caller.

questions.prompt: Which design makes tip calculation easiest to unit test?

options.text: Return the tip without console input or output
Read terminal input inside every calculation

questions.explanation: Explicit inputs and outputs reduce test setup and side effects.

questions.prompt: A method reassigns its object parameter. Does this replace the caller’s variable?

options.text: Only if the parameter is public

questions.explanation: The reassignment changes the local copy of the reference.

questions.prompt: What debugger action enters a called method?
questions.explanation: Step into follows execution into the method body.

questions.prompt: A local variable declared inside a block is normally visible where?

options.text: Within that block after its declaration

questions.explanation: Lexical scope bounds where the name is accessible.

questions.prompt: What should you establish before fixing a reported calculation bug?
questions.explanation: A reproducer lets you confirm both the cause and the repair.
Copies 800 and 10 into the method parameters. 800 * 10 / 100 produces 80. result becomes 80; caller bill remains 800.
